content: युज् I. €7 <ab>U.</ab> (युनक्ति, युङ्क्ते, युयोज, युयुजे, अयुजत्, अयौक्षीत्, अयुक्त, योक्ष्यति-ते, योक्तुम्, युक्त) .²1 To join, unite, attach, connect, add; तमर्थमिव भारत्या सुतया योक्तुमर्हसि <ls>Ku. 6. 79</ls>; see {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} below. .²2 To yoke, harness, put to; भानुः सकृद्युक्ततुरङ्ग एव <ls>Ś. 5. 4</ls>; ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ <ls>Bg. 1. 14</ls>. .²3 To furnish or endow with; as in गुणयुक्त. .²4 To use, employ, apply; प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते <ls>Bg. 17. 26</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 204</ls>. .²5 To appoint, set (with <ab>loc.</ab>); प्रजासु वृत्तिं यमयुङ्क्त वेदितुम् <ls>Ki. 1. 1</ls>. .²6 To direct, turn or fix upon (as the mind <ab>&c.</ab>). .²7 To concentrate oneʼs attention upon; मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः <ls>Bg. 6. 14</ls>; युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानम् <ls n="Bg. 6.">15</ls>. .²8 To put, place or fix on (with <ab>loc.</ab>). .²9 To prepare, arrange, make ready, fit. .²10 To give, bestow, confer; दध्यक्षताद्भिर्युयुजुः सदाशिषः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 25. 29</ls>; आशिषं युयुजे. .²11 To adhere or cleave to. .²12 To enjoin, charge; उवाच चैनं मेधावी युङ्क्ष्वात्मानमिति प्रभो <ls>Mb. 15. 37. 30</ls>. .²13 To put in, insert. .²14 To think or meditate upon. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} (युज्यते) .²1 To be joined or united with; रविपीतजला तपात्यये पुनरोघेन हि युज्यते नदी <ls>Ku. 4. 44</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 17</ls>. .²2 To get, be possessed of; इष्टैर्युज्येथाम् <ls>Mv. 7</ls>; इष्टेन युज्यस्व <ls>Ś. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 65</ls>. .²3 To be fit or right, be proper, to suit (with <ab>loc.</ab> or <ab>gen.</ab>); या यस्य युज्यते भूमिका तां खलु भावेन तथैव सर्वे वर्ग्याः पाठिताः <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; त्रैलोक्यस्यापि प्रभुत्वं त्वयि युज्यते <ls>H. 1</ls>. .²4 To be ready for; ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व <ls>Bg. 2. 38</ls>, <ls n="Bg. 2.">50</ls>. .²5 To be intent on, be absorbed in, be directed towards; दैवकर्मणि युक्तो हि बिभर्तीदं चराचरम् <ls>Ms. 3. 75</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">14. 35</ls>; <ls>Ki. 7. 13</ls> .²6 To be fastened or harnessed. .²7 To adhere, to be in close contact. .²8 To attain to, possess, obtain. .²9 To be made ready. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (योजयति-ते) .²1 To join, unite, bring together; परस्परेण स्पृहणीयशोभं न चेदिदं द्वन्द्वमयोजयिष्यत् <ls>R. 7. 14</ls>. .²2 To present, give, bestow; चरोरर्धार्धभागाभ्यां तामयोजयतामुभे <ls>R. 10. 56</ls>. .²3 To appoint, employ, use; शत्रुभिर्योजयेच्छत्रुम् <ls>Pt. 4. 17</ls>. .²4 To turn or direct towards; पापान्निवारयति योजयते हिताय <ls>Bh. 2. 72</ls>. .²5 To excite, urge, instigate. .²6 To perform, achieve. .²7 To prepare, arrange, equip. .²8 To yoke, harness. .²9 To apply, fix, set, place. .²10 To furnish or endow with. .²11 To surround. .²12 To despise, think lightly of. .²13 To appoint to. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (युयुक्षति-ते) To wish to join, yoke, give <ab>&c.</ab> --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (योजति, योजयति-ते) To unite, join, yoke <ab>&c.</ab>; see युज् above. --III. €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> (युज्यते) To concentrate the mind (identical with the {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} of युज् I). --IV. €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> (योजयते) To censure.

युज् {%a.%} (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Joined or united with, yoked, drawn by <ab>&c.</ab>; रथाः सर्वे चतुर्युजः <ls>Mb. 12. 29. 66</ls>. .²2 Furnished or filled with, possessed of. .²3 Exciting, setting on. .²4 Even, not odd; युक्षु कुर्वन् दिनर्क्षेषु सर्वान् कामान् समश्नुते <ls>Ms. 3. 277</ls>; कामानुकूलानयुजो युजश्च <ls>Mb. 3. 34. 5</ls>. --{%m.%} .²1 A joiner, one who unites or joins. .²2 A sage, one who devotes himself to abstract meditation. .²3 A pair, couple ({%n.%} also in this sense). --{%m.%} dual. .²1 The sign {%Gemini%} of the zodiac. .²2 The two Aśvins.
